skills.description: The 2026 Old Farmer's Almanac — America's oldest continuously published periodical, offering weather forecasts, gardening advice, astronomy, recipes, and useful tips for every day of the year. Covers 5 use cases: ① Weather forecasts and prediction — ("what's the weather going to be" "long range forecast") ② Gardening advice — ("when to plant" "gardening by the moon" "growing tips") ③ Astronomy and sky watching — ("full moon dates" "meteor showers" "sunrise/sunset") ④ Recipes and cooking — ("seasonal recipes" "preserving" "cooking tips") ⑤ Household tips and folklore — ("home remedies" "proverbs" "useful knowledge") Trigger when users say: "Old Farmer's Almanac" "weather forecast" "gardening" "full moon" "when to plant" "growing season" "meteor shower" "sunrise" "sunset" "canning" "preserving" "folklore" "home remedy" "gardening tips" "planting calendar" "moon phases" "frost dates" "hardiness zone" "seasonal recipes" Also triggers when the user says they just installed this skill or doesn't know how to start.
